capabilities.description: Maintain the registry of properties, buildings, floors, room types and individual rooms, with their status and attributes, as the shared reference for every other capability.
Handle the guest stay lifecycle operationally: reservations and arrivals, check-in and check-out, room assignment and moves, and the guest record for the duration of the stay.
Schedule and track cleaning, room turnover, and repair work against rooms and property assets, with work orders, assignment, and completion state.
Segment guests by stay behaviour and value, and drive guest messaging and offers through the channels the property has configured.
Ingest the property's own documents (manuals, SOPs, rate sheets) and answer staff questions from them, with retrieval grounded in the uploaded sources.
Record operational charges and folio-level billing, with currency and tax/VAT regime left as explicit configuration that must be set before any financial rule is generated.
Give management a live view of occupancy, room status, open work orders, and guest activity, in a tenant-scoped dashboard.
Provide the single attach point for external property systems, to be named later; no integration is assumed until the user specifies one.

It serves hotel staff and management (front desk, housekeeping, maintenance, and management), and optionally guests where guest-facing workflows are switched on.
